title: The Market Is About To Shift—Are You Ready?
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: Markets were overbought, have pulled back to support and are nearing oversold levels, so going long makes more sense than shorting for beginners.
Rate-hike probability remains low even after hotter CPI and PPI this week.
CoreWeave debt, Anthropic valuation cut, Chinese memory maker CXMT and a plunging KOSPI are adding fear, but AI and memory demand are real.

calls.reason: Nasdaq pulled back to previous support near 700 and is reaching oversold levels; markets more bullish than bearish, though things may get worse first.
calls.quote: the Nasdaq market that has recently pulled on back. It's reaching its previous support range of 700. I love that

calls.reason: Bought the dip; attractive at these levels with 15-17% recovery potential to ~$1,000, while also day-shorting it intraday.
calls.quote: Micron is attractive enough at these levels that if it does begin to recover, even just to a thousand... 15 to 17% recovery potential.

calls.reason: Expected removal from an MSCI index could force $2.8-3B of fund outflows within days to weeks; views MSTR as a failed software business with no real profit.
calls.quote: I think selling pressure can begin to kick in once it's officially confirmed

calls.condition: if MSTR index removal triggers selling
calls.reason: BTC touching 80,000; MSTR outflows could drag Bitcoin lower. Doesn't believe in crypto.
calls.quote: it could be so bad for MSTR that it could also drag down BTC with it.

calls.reason: Fundamentally overvalued with heavy debt and insider selling, but at previous support with 50-60% recovery potential to conservative highs of 92; technicals rule 2026.
calls.quote: I can see why people can begin to find this area attractive in case it does slightly recover... even to conservative highs of 92.

notes: No weekday said; content implies a trading day (likely Fri 2026-10-16, his Saturday video followed), listing date used. MU price at call not stated (~$855-870 implied by 15-17% to 1,000). CRWV 92 is a possible recovery level he describes, not a firm personal target; he doesn't own it.
